abstract: In this paper, we develop a model for security in Electronic Commerce through of a digital signature and simulations whit cellular automata model to measure the percentage of acceptance for consumers taking into account the strategies that companies should use.

articleTitle: Design of LDPC-based error correcting cipher
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a LDPC error correcting cipher which joints the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) and LDPC code together. The LDPC error correcting cipher which is based on the wide trail strategy is a six round block cipher that encrypts 256 bit plaintexts using secret key to produce 512 bit ciphertexts, and the key is composed of 128 bit AES secret key and LDPC generator matrix. By using the LDPC generator matrix with high performance in diffusion property, we made the LDPC error correcting cipher as secure as the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) against linear, differential attacks in fewer rounds. Even the square attack has no effect on attacking the cipher. Lastly, the process of encrypting/decrypting is implemented, and the security and error correction capacity is analyzed also.

articleTitle: Efficient group key agreement & recovery in ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Ad hoc networks are dynamic peer-to-peer wireless networks composed of a collection of nodes which employ wireless transmission methods in a self-organized way without relying on fixed infrastructure or predetermined connectivity. Such networks pose great challenges in group communication. In this paper, we propose an efficient group key agreement and recovery mechanism based on key escrow systems for ad hoc networks. Nodes randomly change their operation and perform authentication services for specific groups.

articleTitle: An efficient adaptive bit loading for SFBC-OFDM over scattering channel
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This paper studies an adaptive modulation technique combined with space-frequency block coded OFDM (SFBC-OFDM) over scattering channels. Chow's adaptive bit loading algorithm is employed in the two transmitter antennas and two receiver antennas SFBC-OFDM. The channel state information (CSI) for adaptive modulation can be acquired more easily in SFBC-OFDM than in multiple input multiple output (MIMO) OFDM. Scattering channels are discussed on the condition of arbitrary spatially uncorrelated scattering (US) field with arbitrary propagation-loss factors. Then scattering function is presented. Simulation results show that adaptive SFBC-OFDM has 1.5 dB and 5 dB advantage compared with fixed modulation SFBC-OFDM and with adaptive OFDM respectively. Furthermore, adaptive SFBC-OFDM requires less additional power gain than fixed modulation SFBC-OFDM in mobile scattering channel.

articleTitle: A CDMA-assisted seamless handover scheme for WLAN
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: With the development of WLAN (Wireless Local Area Network) technologies, many hotspots have been deployed and mobile devices can get Internet services through WLAN in many places. Some schemes based on the RSS (Receive Signal Strength) have been proposed to provide the seamless handover between WLANs. However, they can not avoid the ping-pong effect, and the handover performance is always influenced, especially when the handover is performed between adjacent cells which are not overlapping with each other very well. So in this paper, we propose a CDMA-assisted handover scheme (CAHO) for WLAN, which uses the CDMA connection during the handover. To evaluate the performance of CAHO, we set up a test-bed and compare it with other schemes. The experimental results show that the CAHO can reduce disruptions and lost packets. Furthermore, it can avoid the ping-pong handovers effectively.

articleTitle: Time hopping encryption techniques
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Different from the encryption techniques based on frequency hopping (FH), this paper discusses the fundamental of order changing operation, puts forward the basic encryption techniques based on time hopping(TH) and discussed some problems in the actual application. Results of the pilot study illuminate that the TH encryption techniques is practical since its high encrypt intensity, simple hardware implement and short running delay that could be adopted in the channel coding to enhance the security of information.

articleTitle: A modified PTS PAPR reduction algorithm with low computational complexity
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: One main drawback in OFDM system is its high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). To solve this problem, a novel PTS algorithm based on modified simulated annealing optimization (MSA-PTS) is proposed in this paper. Specifically, the modified SA optimization approach is applied to search the optimal combination of phase factors, which can avoid the search being trapped in a local optimum solution, and achieve the signal with minimum PAPR without changing the simulated annealing process. Meanwhile, a threshold value is set, which can improve the convergence rate and reduce the computational complexity significantly. Simulations show that MSA-PTS algorithm can achieve good PAPR reduction while obtain low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Explanation of Shannon formula for the UNB communication
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This paper studies the reasoning of the Shannon formula in detail. It points out a promiscuous part in Shannon's reasoning which results in the confliction with the UNB communication. After advancing an improved method and using it into the of VPSK, VMSK and VMSK/2 modulation of the UNB communication theory, we find that the result satisfies the improved Shannon formula.

articleTitle: The development of emergency rescue mobile communication network based on ad hoc technology
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Communication signal coverage and stability can hardly be assured in part of central and western China, where natural disasters happen frequently. Affected by these disasters, communication base station and optical-fibre circuit are easily ruined during disasters. It is necessary to build a set of emergency communication network, which can organize by itself and run without reliance of established fixed base station, in order to release accident information and implement rescue. The network can provide steady and continuous transmitting communication services, and is applied for emergency appeal and accident information release. This system integrates hardware and software, known as “Mobile Ad hoc Network Node for Traffic Accident Rescue and Relief”, abbreviated to MAN2TAR2. Experimental results indicate that MAN<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>TAR<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> system has the following functions: topology change, join in network automatically, continuing transmission, multi-hop routing. This system adopts the IEEE 802.11 protocol, which can provide dozens of mega transmission bandwidth for top application. The multimedia information of image, voice and video can also be transmitted after high compression.

articleTitle: A feedback reduced random beamforming algorithm based on opportunistic eigenbeamforming system
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Opportunistic beamforming(OBF) is a powerful technique that exploits multiuser diversity to increase the system throughput on the downlink correlated wireless channels. Opportunistic eigenbeamforming(OEB) can achieve larger multiuser diversity gain than OBF under different degrees of channel correlation but it need additional feedback. This paper proposes a feedback reduced random beamforming algorithm based on OEB. In the proposed method, each user computes the correlation factor of the beamforming vectors generated by OBF and OEB. Those users whose correlation factor is greater than the predefined threshold feed back their SNRs, others don't need to feed back SNRs, thus the base station choose the best user to transmit data. Simulation results show that the performance of the proposed algorithm is asymptotic to that of OEB while the overall feedback is significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Improving upper bound on the capacity of planar wireless networks with omnidirectional antennas
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, we improve the upper bounds on the maximum number of simultaneously successful wireless transmissions and the maximum achievable per-node end-to-end throughput under the same general network scenario as in Arpacioglu and Haas (2004) [1].

articleTitle: A note on pair-interleaving construction for LCZ and ZCZ sequence sets
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, a new proof of a construction of LCZ sequence set is given. Also is given an analysis of pair-interleaving construction.

articleTitle: Trust extended object-oriented security model
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: With the development of Internet and its application, mobile code technique has become a hot research area in latest years. Because mobile codes have strong ability of being independent, autonomic, mobile, and mixed with data, it's ineffective to handle their security issues with traditional access control systems. Inspired by the integration of trusted computing and object-oriented method, we propose a new trust extended object-oriented security model-TEOOSM, which can be applied to the access control system of mobile codes. Our model encapsulates the code and data, utilizes the trusted status measurement, and then effectively protects platforms, codes and data from being destroyed by malicious codes or systems.

articleTitle: Real time and dynamic searching path algorithm based on character state auto machine
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Road games against Dynamic Network of Route finding easily into traps, Route finding efficiency is not high, the state will automatically figure of the LRTA * and the weighted (Learning Real Time A *) combining algorithm was proposed, based on figures state machine Real-time dynamic path algorithm. By changing the valuation function of the updated rules and reconciliation of time compromise the quality of the relative speed up convergence algorithm, the introduction of artificial search and signs, completion of LRTA * algorithm optimization, improve search efficiency. Running through the examples show that the method than the traditional A * algorithm Route finding faster convergence on satisfactory solution, which is a network game in the search for an effective way to the optimal path.

articleTitle: Acoustic source localization in noisy wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Target localization is one of the typical applications of wireless sensor networks. However, there are few localization algorithms addressing the problems caused by both the noisy wireless channels and the limited sensing range and energy of sensor nodes. In this paper, a new source localization algorithm based on maximum likelihood (ML) estimation incorporating wireless channel impact is proposed. The Cramer-Rao Bound (CRB) of the ML acoustic source location estimate has been derived to analyze the accuracy of location estimations. Extensive simulations have been conducted. The results show that this proposed ML method can reach its CRB performance bound with relatively small amount of data and consistently outperforms the source localization methods without considering the channel impact.

articleTitle: Vector Switching Scheme (VSS) for Source Routing Protocol of MANET
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: A Mobile Ad hoc NETwork (MANET) is a group of mobile nodes which cooperate in forwarding packets in a multi-hop fashion without any centralized administration. One of its key challenges is routing. Many routing protocols for MANETs have been proposed and the protocols can be classified as proactive routing and on demand routing protocols. The later protocols without periodic routing updates scale better. Dynamic Source Routing (DSR) protocol is a popular on demand protocol of MANET. It uses explicit “source routing” in data packet header to lead packet to destination. This allows other nodes forwarding any of these packets to cache this routing information easily for future use. However, this protocol has a high overhead of packet header. In this paper, we present a new packet forwarding scheme, Vector Switching Scheme which employs Vector Address (VA) to replace source route in packets, for source routing. The proposed scheme reduces overhead of packet header in source routing and enhances packet transfer performance.

articleTitle: Moving object segmentation and enhancement based wireless video monitoring of coal mine
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: An efficient moving object segmentation algorithm which can overcome inherent drawbacks of common Change Detection Mask (CDM) and the video enhancement algorithm which is special for coal mine video monitoring system are proposed in the paper. After simulating and comprising by subjective estimation, it is shown that these processes can segment the motion object completely and improve the video quality of monitoring system in coal mine underground by enhancing the local texture of interested region with the lower bit rate at the same time.

articleTitle: Cyclic shift interleaver for turbo product codes
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, Cyclic shift interleaver for Turbo Product Codes is introduced. The interleaving process has two steps which are firstly each row is cyclically shifted to right direction by specific value and then each column is cyclically shifted to down direction by specific value. It helps product code to correct the crisscross errors or rectangular shape errors and is shown robust characteristics under burst errors. It is compared with Diagonal readout interleaver and is shown that the bit error performance of Cyclic shift interleaver under a narrowband interference is better than that of Diagonal readout interleaver.

articleTitle: Construction of good Quasi-Cyclic LDPC codes based on the row vectors of generator matrix
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: The existing construction of Quasi-Cyclic low-density parity-check (short for QC-LDPC) codes has not considered the problems of small stopping sets and small girth and small minimum code weight together, while their existences will lead to the BER performance of QC-LDPC codes to be much poorer than that of randomly constructed LDPC codes even decoding failure. To solve the problem, some theorems of the QC-LDPC codes without small stopping sets and small girth were proposed first. Then good QC-LDPC codes without small stopping sets and small girth were designed based on the row vectors of generator matrix. The small minimum code weight also can be prevented due to the new algorithm based on the row vectors of generator matrix, which is the new way to choose the shifted factors to construct the good QC-LDPC codes for the given prime. The effectiveness and the practicability of the algorithm are demonstrated by the simulation results. It is significant for us to analyze and optimize the design of LDPC codes.

articleTitle: Construction of the virtual environment based on Java3D
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Java3D is a set of APIs which is the Java's expansion in the three-dimensional field based on OpenGL. It implements the characteristics of real-time and interactivity in the three-dimensional environment. By integrating with Java, we build a visual media platform where we can construct a virtual environment and interact with this environment. Using the wave font model as the basic elements of the environment, we construct a three-dimensional virtual environment based on the thought of the Java3D scene graph, and implement a simple scene interaction. Also, the platform has some other functions, including three-dimensional reconstruction, sports capture, and video or voice interaction which will be implemented later.

articleTitle: Study on the communication link quality in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Firstly, the hardware and software platform is established to demonstrate our system's basic functions with the protocol IEEE 802.15.4. Hardware design about gateway and nodes are described briefly. Secondly, when our demonstration system works, received signal strength (RSSI) and correlation value of symbols of the received packet (CORR) can been obtained from the chip CC2420, the relationship of which is researched under the different received packet rate circumstances. The curve figure shows the special relation and theoretic limited values. In the end, the linear relation between RSSI and LQI is calculated. Utilizing it, these two values can been converted each other.

articleTitle: Converting real images to SVG based on XML
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This paper presents a novel method to convert raster images in a Scalable Vector Graphic (SVG) format using similar features of pixel. The approach starts image segmentation for raster images with similar features of gray scale or color; we obtain the edges of image segmentation, which is rendered by SVG with polygon or Bezier curve. Then we merge the obtained SVG graphics with different region edges for similar features of pixel because the converted SVG is very large size. Experimental results prove the SVG rendering effectiveness of our method and good performance for converting raster images. The SVG rendering approach is very useful for Virtual- museum explore design on network.

articleTitle: Multipath signal blind separation in mobile communications
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: The normal communication is interfered with multipath reflection. Multipath reflection is changing during the mobile process. In this paper, a new method for adaptive deconvolution is presented, which is used for the blind separation in the changing multipath reflection signals. The adaptive deconvolution algorithm is improved in the affected gradient noise, the deconvolution adaptive learning speed and the system's stability. This paper confirms the validity of new method by the theory and the simulative results on computer.

articleTitle: Innovative wearable biomedical sensors for wireless ECG signs monitoring
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: An electrocardiogram (ECG) is a graphic tracing of the electric current generated by the heart muscle during a heartbeat. It provides information on the condition and performance of the heart. One of today's most pressing matters in heart disease is the response time to patients in need. The scope of this paper is to suggest a solution that would help reduce response time in emergency situations utilizing wireless sensor networks technology. Wireless sensor network researches have recently gained unprecedented momentum in both industries and academia, especially its potential applications in Emergency Medical Services and Intensive Care Units. The enhanced power efficiency, minimized production cost, condensed physical layout, as well as reduced wired connections, presents a much more proficient and simplified approach to the continuous monitoring of patients' physiological status. It is the aim of this paper to develop a prototype of an ECG wireless sensor node. Some implementation details are explained showing how the solution can be effectively implemented and deployed.

articleTitle: A novel overlapped area localization method in large-scale wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In many applications of wireless sensor networks, message localization is very important to determine the place where events incur and the position where data come from. We present a new anchor-free overlapped area localization method which divides the target area into a serial of grid cells in a round. The overlapped area of the cells created by different round is used to determine the minimum area within which the unknown node resides. Then, the centroid of the area is taken as the location of the node. Finally, through simulation we prove the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Components for RFID equipped forklift trucks
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This contribution describes how Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is used to track and trace goods transported by forklift trucks. RFID hardware components are integrated in forklift trucks and goods carriers such as pallets and pallet cages. Information about transport and handling of goods can be stored locally within these goods carriers. New components, which are developed to join RFID functionality with forklift trucks' control devices, are presented. Vehicle sensors and the RFID reader unit are then combined to form a new event-driven approach to integrate forklift trucks as a part of management assistant systems. Forklift trucks are enabled to communicate with these systems by means of a wireless LAN. It is also discussed how vehicle sensors can be displaced by using the RFID reader as a sensor.

articleTitle: A PN sequence-based carrier frequency offset estimation algorithm for generalized-OFDMA uplink
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: We propose a pseudo-noise (PN) sequence-based carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation algorithm for generalized-orthogonal frequency division multiple access (generalized-OFDMA) uplink. In proposed algorithm, a PN sequence and its circular-shifting versions are employed as training sequences for different users; Then channel parameters with CFO factors from each user to a base station can be estimated by virtue of autocorrelation characteristic of the PN sequence; Finally we can acquire all users' CFO estimates simultaneously by calculating channel phase-angle difference between two training periods. We demonstrate from the simulation that the proposed algorithm achieves better CFO estimation performance in comparison with some existing CFO estimation algorithms for OFDMA uplink.

articleTitle: Multicast method based on new network technique
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This paper presents a method of multicast which is available in a new third-layer network called Vector Network by analysing and using the property of this network. This method bases on the new way of address coding, uses the characteristic of hierarchical routing architecture. We can build a Multicast Distribution Tree that is the path of multicast data packets by invoking Minimum Spanning Tree Algorithm distributedly and recursively by this method. In terms of total cost,the multicast cost will be minimum along the Multicast Distribution Tree. Additionally, a new vector address format has been designed which has a dendriform structure. The cost of multicast can be decreased greatly by using this new vector address format.

articleTitle: Crossover product accumulate codes: EXIT analysis and performance
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Crossover product accumulate (CPA) codes, proposed recently, are a novel class of provably good error-correcting codes with low encoding and decoding complexity. In this paper, EXIT chart is used to predict the SNR convergence threshold of CPA codes. Iterative decoding stop criteria are proposed for CPA codes, and are used to simulate the performance of CPA codes. Analysis and simulations show that CPA codes provide a lower error floor than product accumulate (PA) codes, while CPA codes possess the same convergence threshold as PA codes, and the iterative decoding stop criteria proposed can reduce the decoding complexity and achieve excellent bit-error-rate (BER) performance.

articleTitle: A robust decision-directed channel estimator for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This paper deals with the estimation of channel frequency response in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. Since existing DD estimators such as LS estimator and the MMSE estimator do not appropriately reduce the influence brought by incorrect decision, and hence suffer from error propagation. Then, in order to mitigate error propagation in DD channel estimation, a DD estimator based on iterative LMMSE is proposed. The algorithm takes the error vector as innovation for the current channel state information (CSI), then calculates the impact that the innovation brings to the current CSI estimation according to the orthogonallity principle and then modify the current CSI, thereby the effect induced by error can be reduced. Simulation results show that the proposal can effectively track the time variations in both the Multipath channel and AWGN channel.

articleTitle: A mobile scale-free network model for hybrid ad hoc and sensor network
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: With the growing people's demands for a variety of daily life and work information at anytime, anywhere, in this paper, we present a new mobile applications scenario. Sensors, a large number of mobile phones, PDAs, and laptop computers self-organize into a hybrid ad hoc and sensor network. A small portion of mobile phone nodes from the hybrid network can be chosen as long-range nodes to communicate with some long distance mobile phone nodes through cellular network. Next, we put forward a mobile scale-free network model for the ad hoc network of the hybrid network. The model takes nodes mobility and complex network characteristic such as growth, preferential attachment, link removals, nodes fitness, and local-world into account. Simulation result shows that comparatively small long-range links can make the network be scale-free.

articleTitle: An antenna with fractal PBG structure designed for modern UWB system
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: For the requirements of ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna, we designed a meandered-line antenna with fractal PBG structure, which can completely cover all the frequency segments of UWB system (3.1 ∼ 10.6 GHz). The size of the antenna is minimized greatly, only 30 mm × 32 mm ×0.8 mm. The simulated results show that for VSWR less than 2, the working frequency segment of the antenna is 2.91 ∼ 11.53 GHz, at which the lowest return loss value S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> is −17.17 dB. Meanwhile, the antenna bandwidth is up to 8.62 GHz absolutely and 119.39% relatively; the frequency multiple bandwidth is up to 3.96 GHz. Considering the engineering processes, the influences of dielectric constant ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> and thickness of circuit board on the antenna's performance are particularly studied. We also discussed the fractal PBG structure in detail, including its size and arrangement regulation. At last, the contrast analysis on different radiation characteristics of the antenna while being sticked on various materials has been done to validate the function stability.

articleTitle: Spectrum reuse schemes for OFDMA cellular networks with fixed relay stations
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of spectrum reuse in the broadband Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) cellular system with two-hop fixed relay nodes operating in decode-and-forward and half-duplex mode. Two novel spectrum reuse schemes are proposed to improve the spectral efficiency, both of which have good trade-offs between multi-user diversity and interference coordination. One aims to exploit higher multi-user diversity and the other develops a novel spectrum reuse framework which can achieve much higher spectral efficiency. It is demonstrated through intensive system-level simulation the performance of our proposed spectrum reuse schemes are superior to several known spectrum reuse schemes. Besides, both proposed schemes support uniform and non-uniform traffic distribution.

articleTitle: Analysis of group multiuser detection based on coalitional game
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: The issue of group-blind multiuser detection in MAC channel among wireless nodes in the environment of multiple networks coexisting and sharing spectrum is addressed under the Framework of coalitional game. We investigate the performance and stability of multiple access channel (MAC) with linear decorrelating multiuser detection under varying SNR, channel gains and coalitional structures, in which both single BS and multiple BSs cases were considered. The main results and conclusion are as follows: (1) the grand coalition is payoff maximizing under loose SNR; (2) it is in conformity with group and coalitional rationality forming coalition among nodes that have comparative channel gains.

articleTitle: A modified PIC method used in cooperative communication system under imperfect synchronization
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, a simple and effective PIC (Parallel Interference Cancellation) method without pilot was proposed for the case that the signal transmission under the imperfect synchronization from relay nodes to the destination node. This scheme utilizing iteration cancels the interference components in the received signals. Applying two antennas in destination node, the effect of this proposed method can be even more apparent. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme not only improved BER performance but also retains a lower structural and computational complexity than the conventional scheme without synchronization.

articleTitle: Entire-frame error concealment in H.264 using motion tracking and adaptive block sizes
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Since H.264 provides high compression efficiency, a coded frame has a small size and can be encapsulated into a single network packet. Therefore, the loss of a single packet results in the loss of an entire frame, and then the error propagates to successive frames. In this paper, we propose a novel entire-frame error concealment method for H.264. First, the proposed method extrapolates motion vectors of 8×8 blocks and 4×4 blocks from neighboring frames onto the lost frame by motion tracking. Then, an appropriate conceal size of 4×4 or 8×8 is selected according to the overlapping area. Finally, the extrapolated motion vectors are refined by searching the best-match motion vector among the neighboring motion vectors. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the conventional methods. This method is also applicable to the loss of non-entire frame.

articleTitle: Location-aided multicast routing optimization with bandwidth restraint
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: One of Overlay multicast research is its related topology design for the routing optimization. To improve the related robustness and scalability issues, this paper proposed a location-aided multicast routing scheme based on genetic algorithm (GARouting) to construct a region-divided topology tree for the multicast routing in overlay network. The scheme firstly accessed the geographic information of Multicast Service Nodes to build the region-divided topology structure for the routing scalability. And then GARouting selected genetic algorithm to implement the region division operation for the routing robustness. Finally the scheme applied a multicast SPT method to form a region-divided routing tree. Simulation results demonstrated that the proposed scheme indicates better routing performance in terms of robustness and scalability.

articleTitle: A novel preprocessing scheme for multiuser downlink spatial multiplexing MIMO system
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: This paper proposes a combined inter-user interference minimization scheme for multiuser multi-input multi-output (MU-MIMO) system. For transmit antenna number is small, the proposed scheme improves the signal-to-interference-plus-noise (SINR) based on a modified SLNR approach. When the constraint is free, the proposed scheme is able to force the multiuser interference (MUI) to zero at each user. The proposed algorithm achieves good bit error rate (BER) performance, has low complexity, and is suitable for practical system. Simulation results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed precoding algorithm.

articleTitle: Opportunistic cooperation diversity in wireless networks
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, we present two new opportunistic cooperation schemes that are referred to as the SDC-based (selection diversity combining based) and the MRC-based (maximum ra-tio combing based) opportunistic cooperation, respectively. The closed form expressions of outage probability for the proposed opportunistic cooperation schemes are also derived for Rayleigh fading channels. For the purpose of comparison, the outage analysis of the known deterministic cooperation is further provided, with the numerical results justifying the advantage of our schemes over the deterministic cooperation. Besides, we conduct a performance comparison between the MRC-based opportunistic cooperation and the SDC-based opportunistic cooperation, showing the merits of the former scheme in terms of outage probability.

articleTitle: A new scheme for accounting based on Vector Network
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new scheme for accounting in the context of one kind of new communication network called Vector Network (VN). As we all know, in Internet protocol (IP) network, Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) network, and other networks, some traditional schemes for accounting have been in use. However, various disadvantages have been observed in the appliance process of such traditional schemes. Furthermore, hardly could they meet the need of increasing complicated and sophisticated networks for the reason that most of those schemes are, to some extent, simplified approaches for accounting. Based on thorough analysis and comprehension to such schemes for accounting applied in nowadays networks, this paper proposes a new one, which is originally designed for VN.

articleTitle: A Video-on-Demand streaming service architecture based on hybrid P2P
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: The Quality of Experience in current P2P VoD streaming systems is unsatisfactory because of the long latencies to search data segments. To address this problem, we propose a Video-on-Demand streaming service architecture based on hybrid P2P—HP2VoD. By arranging the peers that cache the same data segment into a group, and arranging the groups whose segments form an entire program into a ring, HP2VoD promptly finds any media segment and the peers that cache the segment within the ring. Routing tasks are not distributed across all system peers. Analysis and results show HP2VoD effectively addresses the problem of how to quickly search data segments in P2P VoD system supporting VCR controls.

articleTitle: Sub-path congestion control for Concurrent Multipath Transfer
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: We proposed a sub path congestion control principle for SCTP (SPCC-SCTP) with bandwidth-aware source scheduling by dividing an association into sub paths based on shared bottleneck detection to overcome existing flaws of standard SCTP in supporting the multi-homing feature in the case of Concurrent Multipath Transfer (CMT). The performance of the SPCC-SCTP is assessed through ns-2 experiments in a simplified Diff-Serv network. Simulation results demonstrated the effectiveness of our proposed mechanism and invite further research.

Author Keywords: Sub-Path Congestion Control principle for SCTP (SPCC-SCTP)

articleTitle: Study on campus wireless mobile model based on AOC modeling
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: With regard to the fundamental problem of the MANET routing protocols, this paper according to the campus mobile node behaviour, aims to establish a campus wireless mobile model based on AOC system. Through NS-2 simulation platform extensive simulate result and analysis of different mobile fashion which effect on the MANET routing protocol performance: in the aspect of Packet Delivery Ratio,DSR and AODV both surpass 95%, were not greatly affected by the changes of node mobile rate; DSDV and DSR closed to the Path Optimality.

articleTitle: Design of RFID active tag system based on MSP430
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Saving power and extending identification distance are important problems in portables. This paper presents a system on chip for radio frequency identification (RFID) active tag to extend the identification distance and battery life. It uses hardware and software to execute the checking, identifying and real time anti-collision. RF module and active tag system have been completed. Methods for low power consumption and a simple practical adjusting approach for RF module are introduced. The proposed system has advantages such as simple structure, low cost, and low energy electron diffraction. This system is successfully used in 433/868/915 MHz RFID. When TX power is adjusted by the software, the identification distance is between 80meters and 120meters.

articleTitle: Wireless scheduling algorithm using dynamic compensation mode
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Wireless scheduling algorithm have received more and more attention due to the performance of delay and channel utility, but rarely consider the dynamic reallocation and compensation mode. In this paper, we use dynamic compensation mode to achieve wireless scheduling. It can distinguish the services in different application levels and achieve wireless dynamic services for higher priority, which compensate bandwidth to the trouble connection only from those higher priority. While reallocation mode in the algorithm is dynamic allot bandwidth only to those higher priority. Simulation results show that the system's performance have further improved by using dynamic compensation mode and dynamic reallocation mode, the flows of higher priority have get more services. With the development of wireless IP network, wireless dynamic scheduling is a promising approach and deserves more future research.

articleTitle: Delay-aware opportunistic scheduling for real-time service in OFDMA systems
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Scheduling algorithm for OFDMA system plays an important role in supporting users' diverse QoS requirements, especially for real-time service. In this paper, we propose a delay-aware opportunistic scheduling algorithm (DAOS) that can guarantee QoS requirement for real-time service and provide effective fairness among all users. The benefit is attained from utilizing queue state information (QSI) and channel state information (CSI) jointly and updating scheduling parameters during subchannel allocation procedure. Simulation results illustrate that the max packet loss ratio and delay are both improved by the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Hierarchical route optimization scheme in mobile network
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Network Mobility (NEMO) is being concerned as a new mobility issue. Many NEMO issues have received much attention in research community where route optimization is a most important one. With NEMO Basic Support Protocol (NBS), all the communications to and from a node in a mobile network must go through the bi-directional tunnel established between mobile router and its home agent, which may bring redundant route. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical route optimization scheme in mobile network (HROS) to solve mobility management and route optimization problems. HROS uses MAP which is a mobility management technique in HMIPv6 to construct a hierarchical architecture, a detailed route optimization scheme is designed under this architecture to eliminate pinball routing within mobile network.

articleTitle: On increasing system throughput for non real-time users using hierarchical modulation in IEEE802.16 network
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel cross-layer approach of opportunistic scheduling to increase system throughput for IEEE 802.16 downlink transmission. Traditionally wireless users are scheduled according to the type of their subscribed service. The key idea of this paper is to combine hierarchical modulation with opportunistic scheduling, which not only yields a larger over-all system throughput, but also maintains the fairness determined by the type of traffic. As shown by the provided simulation results, the total information capacity for non real-time user is increased without penalising much on the real-time user.

articleTitle: A novel overlay multicast routing scheme based on topology community detection
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Current overlay multicast research focuses on its routing optimization fully considering its related network topology characteristics. To solve the multicast scalability issue, this paper proposed a novel multicast routing algorithm (S-MSPT) for the overlay network, inspired by the topology community detection in complex network theory. S-MSPT firstly mapped MSNs (Multicast Service Node) to a 2-dimension feature space. Then it divided MSNs into the communities and selected one MSN as the community center based on a clustering method. Finally the scheme applied a heuristic method to form a SPT-based hierarchical routing topology based on inter-community MSNs (composed by community centers and source MSN) and intra-community MSNs (rooted by its center) respectively. The experiments demonstrated that the proposed scheme is effective in the topology detection and the routing design with better scalable performance.

articleTitle: A collusion-resisted public key traitor tracing scheme
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new public key traitor tracing scheme resisting collusion attack by means of polynomial on finite field. The remarkable difference between our scheme and other schemes is that in our scheme the private decryption key of a user is not a share (a point on the polynomial) of the selected polynomial, which results in some notable characteristics that no coconspirator can generate a private key and retrieve the secret polynomial selected by Data-Supplier. In addition, our scheme is of black box tracing, dynamically revoking and recovering traitors. Its security is based on the difficulty of solving Discrete Logarithm problems in finite field.

articleTitle: Study on mobile IP technology in wireless communication systems
publicationTitle: IET 2nd International Conference on Wireless, Mobile and Multimedia Networks (ICWMMN 2008)
abstract: Wireless communication systems beyond the third generation will be diverse. In this paper, we propose mobile IP as one enabling technology for active wireless /mobile networking. It can be expected that several different mobile IP technologies as well as several classes of mobile devices running a variety of applications will be deployed, while the IP will play the role of the unifying architectural component.
